takes.first: The North Gate reopened while I was buying bread.
North Gate had spent weeks becoming ordinary by being unavailable.
takes.last: One foot simply failed to take the next step.

takes.first: Later North Gate did not have those straps.
takes.last: CLOSURE AFTER HEAVY FREEZE, STRUCTURAL SHIFT, OR SUPPORT FAULT.

takes.first: Outside the gate, north-road traffic had already begun reorganizing itself.
I had spent weeks treating that future fact like a shadow over every current decision.
Sella was behind the desk sorting canceled slips into one pile and active slips into another.
takes.last: I counted everything twice because the foreman paid for accurate numbers, not personal development.

takes.first: By evening, north-road carts were audible from Lower Rook again.
takes.last: It was starting to feel like citizenship...
